name: Death Detective
source:
Death Detective is a horror investigative visual novel set in rural coastal town in New England about a detective being contracted by [redacted] herself to track down a wizard before something irreparable happens.

[Edited from [url=https://aster-zerone.itch.io/death-detective]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《死亡侦探》是一部以新英格兰沿海乡村小镇为背景的恐怖调查视觉小说，讲述了一名侦探与[redacted]签约，在无法挽回的事情发生之前追查一名巫师的故事。

[编辑自[url=https://aster-zerone.itch.io/death-detective]itch.io[/url]]
